selected_property.title: Coefficient-array bounds safety over the full 256-iteration loop
selected_property.candidate_statement: The loop in mlk_poly_add iterates i from 0 to MLKEM_N-1 with MLKEM_N = 256, so a candidate CBMC harness can check that r->coeffs[i] and b->coeffs[i] are always accessed within the declared coefficient array bounds for all iterations.

supporting_evidence.supports_claim: The loop covers exactly the 256 coefficient indices in order.
The coefficient storage is a fixed-size MLKEM_N-element array.

required_assumptions: The harness should use the same compiled configuration in which MLKEM_N resolves to 256.
r and b must each point to a valid mlk_poly object with at least MLKEM_N coefficients accessible.
selected_property.expected_artifact_type: Bounded-loop CBMC harness or direct contract check for coefficient indexing
out_of_scope_boundaries: Do not extend this into any claim about polynomial multiplication, NTT correctness, or serialization size.
Do not infer anything about coefficient values beyond index safety from this property alone.
selected_property.uncertainty: Index safety is strongly supported by the fixed array type and loop bound, but the harness still depends on valid object allocation and the CBMC configuration being consistent with the headers.
limitations: This property checks access safety, not arithmetic correctness.
It is a local property of mlk_poly_add only.

assumption_plan.description: Use the actual C types, macros, and function signature from raw source/header evidence.
Use explicit pointer validity and object-size assumptions where pointer parameters are present.
If the target mutates an object in place, snapshot old state before calling the function.

assertion_plan.description: Assertions must check only the selected local property, not full ML-KEM correctness.
Avoid assertions that are made trivially true by over-strong assumptions.

content.warning: This deterministic plan is advisory only. The LLM must independently produce the authoritative artefact plan.
